identity.title: Capture a minimal production-derived EverRun governance fixture

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: After 8065-8069, distill the successful raw EverRun package path into the smallest privacy-screened canonical fixture that preserves only the governance facts needed to reproduce lifecycle, decision-domain, validation and scope projection. This fixture is derived from production evidence but must not copy raw history, prompts, patches, secrets or unrelated telemetry.
human_pressure.why_now: The direct producer fix needs a durable regression artifact or the same cross-repo contract can silently break again.
do_not_misread: Do not commit a full real run.
Do not invent facts absent from the accepted raw package.

machine_core.goal: Create one minimal canonical evidence-package fixture derived from the accepted 8065/8066 raw EverRun evidence and prove it reproduces the same canonical facts through the existing pipeline.
invariants: Fixture facts are traceable to the accepted raw package.
Only minimal canonical events needed for the reproduced facts are retained.
Sanitization may replace incidental identifiers but must not change event semantics.
Unknown source-private telemetry is omitted only because it is irrelevant to this focused regression fixture, not because unknown is treated as clean.

steps.title: Derive minimal evidence set
details: Use only the raw package accepted by 8065/8066.
Select the minimum events proving terminal lifecycle, execution-control decision domain, validation status and scope status.

steps.title: Privacy screen and canonicalize fixture identity
details: Remove unrelated telemetry and sensitive payload data.
Preserve semantic values and contract shape; do not fabricate absent governance facts.

steps.title: Add focused replay proof
details: Load, ingest and rebuild the fixture through production functions.
Assert the same canonical lifecycle/validation/scope/decision facts proven in 8066.

acceptance: Fixture validates under the unchanged canonical validator.
Fixture contains no raw history, prompts, patches or secrets.

producer.artifact: minimal canonical evidence-package fixture derived from 8065/8066 raw evidence

consumer.component: evidence package validator and import pipeline

observable_effect.assertion: A minimal canonical fixture validates under the unchanged validator and reproduces source-proven facts.

proofs.assertion: Fixture validates and import/replay reproduces canonical facts.

must_check: 8065 and 8066 are complete before deriving the fixture.
Every retained semantic fact is source-proven by the accepted raw package.
No canonical validator relaxation or new producer branch exists.
reject_if: Raw runtime history or sensitive payloads are committed.
Facts are invented to make the fixture clean.
The fixture bypasses the production loader/ingest/projection path.
Unknown evidence is rewritten as clean.
